newsitem.title: GERMANY: LTU plans online electronic ticket auctions.
newsitem.headline: LTU plans online electronic ticket auctions.

text.p: German holiday airline LTU International Airways said it will hold electronic ticket auctions on the Compuserve online service.
Consumers will be invited to place bids for selected destinations with the highest bidder gaining the ticket, a company statement said.
LTU said it will hold a first seven-day electronic auction on its new Compuserve site from October 7 offering six tickets to each of five destinations.
The airline will fix both the minimum and maximum sum which can be offered for a particular destination, it added.
LTU said it would hold regular electronic auctions on the Compuserve in future. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
